items.name: Bornholm Winter 2027
items.information:
Dette er den femte konkurrence afholdt på Bornholm - deltagere i alle hastigheder er velkommen til denne konkurrence!

This is the fifth competition held on Bornholm - we welcome participants of all speeds to this competition!

items.name: Oahu FTO a Makapō 2027
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDgyNDQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d739808be3a2373fd1129978150c3798d3405ee0/IMG_1309.png)
### The competition weekend in Oʻahu continues with an amazing side events competition!

---

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.

---

### This competition will be specializing in niche events and will not have 3x3 or any traditional events. If you would like to sign up for a competition involving those events, please check out [Cube Against Cancer Hawaii 2027](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeAgainstCancerHawaii2027), happening on January 30th, the day before.

items.name: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines Nationals 2027
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjMwMDA2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--97a368da9c2de5730f34fd117f5c205ff16be083/SaintVincentandtheGrenadinesNationals2027_logo.png)

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbXFIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--21ca44b60799bf464134d7d44eddd25b4260efdf/Cubing%20Frontiers%20LLC%20Banner%20Transparent.png)

The first WCA competition in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines! 🇻🇨 Cubers of all ages and skill levels are encouraged to sign up.

This competition serves as the **2027 National Championship for Saint Vincent and the Grenadines**. Competitors of all nationalities are welcome to participate; however, only competitors who are nationals of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines are eligible to receive prizes.
